description: BOS, 2005 June regular phase: 53 of 53 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 53 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 53 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240721030943: 53 listed, 53 matched to MLB's picks by name (4 by surname in the same round: #468 MLB "Patrick Thomas" / "P.J. Thomas"; #498 MLB "Matthew Mercurio" / "Matt Mercurio"; #828 MLB "Matthew Hancock" / "Matt Hancock"; #888 MLB "Christopher Jones" / "Chris Jones")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
